programme: Master of Arts in Children and Adolescent Counseling

parts.title: Foundations of Adolescent Development
parts.blurb: The intellectual scaffolding of the course: what adolescence is, how it has been studied, which theories explain it, how evidence is built, and how developmental knowledge becomes professional competence in the counselling room.

chapters.subtitle: Definitions, boundaries, stages and the developmental meaning of the second decade of life.

chapters.title: Historical, Cultural and Scientific Foundations of Adolescence Research
chapters.subtitle: From storm and stress to developmental science: how the study of adolescence was built.

chapters.title: Theoretical Frameworks I: Biological, Psychosexual and Psychosocial Theories
chapters.subtitle: Puberty-centred, Freudian and Erikson readings of the adolescent transition.

chapters.title: Theoretical Frameworks II: Cognitive, Learning and Ecological Theories
chapters.subtitle: Piaget, Vygotsky, learning theory, Bronfenbrenner and the systems that organise adolescent growth.

chapters.title: Research Methods and Evidence in Adolescent Development

chapters.title: The Ecological Contexts of Adolescence
chapters.subtitle: Family, school, peers, neighbourhood, media and culture as one connected developmental system.

chapters.title: Developmental Tasks, Transitions and Timing
chapters.subtitle: What adolescents must accomplish, when transitions help or hurt, and why timing matters.

chapters.title: From Development to Practice: What Counsellors Must Know
chapters.subtitle: Translating developmental science into assessment, formulation, intervention and advocacy.

parts.blurb: The body in transition: puberty, the developing brain, sleep, sexuality, body image, movement, illness and disability, and what each means for adolescents and for the counsellors who serve them.

chapters.title: Puberty: Hormones, Growth and Physical Change
chapters.subtitle: The endocrine choreography of puberty and its psychological meaning for adolescents.

chapters.title: Brain Development in Adolescence

chapters.title: Sexual Development and Sexual Health in Adolescence
chapters.subtitle: Sexual maturation, romantic interest, health behaviour, consent and developmentally appropriate support.

chapters.title: Body Image, Nutrition, Eating and Weight Concerns
chapters.subtitle: How adolescents evaluate their changing bodies, and when concern becomes clinical risk.

chapters.title: Physical Activity, Sport and the Developing Body
chapters.subtitle: Movement, motor development, sport participation, dropout and the counselling significance of the active body.

chapters.title: Chronic Illness, Disability and Health in Adolescence
chapters.subtitle: Growing up with a health condition: adherence, autonomy, identity and family negotiation.
